items.headline: New US bill could reshape accountability for domestic fashion manufacturing
items.blurb: Design teams may need to audit and document labor practices across US supply chains if the FABRIC Act passes.

items.headline: Bangladesh Minimum Wage Increase Fails to Bridge Worker-Maker Divide
items.blurb: Brands face pressure to absorb costs as the modest raise creates friction across supply chains.

items.headline: Rh+ Debuts Luxe Skiwear With Thermore's Sustainable Insulation
items.blurb: Combining premium fabrics like velvet with eco-friendly padding technology offers designers a new template for performance luxury outerwear.

items.headline: Japan funds Ethiopia factory upgrade program for 1.1M
items.blurb: Strengthened supplier compliance with global standards means more reliable sourcing options and reduced risk for brands sourcing from Ethiopian manufacturers.

items.headline: Swedish textile service sector convenes to tackle industry headwinds
items.blurb: Understanding sector challenges helps design teams anticipate supply chain shifts and service standards affecting production timelines.
